translation_notes: one namespace term becomes a prefixed name in place: RDFS.subClassOf -> rdfs:subClassOf. That is the entire translation -- the filter, the comprehension and the sort are Python.
only 1 of the 14 drafted @prefix declarations was kept (rdfs); the rdflib.namespace import block is left exactly as upstream even though RDFS becomes dead there.

FINDING: a read-only region is where ldpy has least to offer. There is no filtering island, so the lambda that drops blank nodes and ignored classes stays Python, and the payoff is a single token. This is the low end of the notation's usefulness -- worth contrasting with the construction-heavy regions of the same batch.

context shim (identical on both sides): supermodel_shim.py holds a reduced Class dataclass (iri, name + the iri-based __eq__ copied from model.py lines 167-185), because pylode/__init__.py imports 'dominate' and the full dataclass drags in Property/Note/Ontology. Class is needed at def time for the 'list[Class]' return annotation; the 14-name model import is trimmed to it.

the region was extracted as a module-level function, so the driver passes a stand-in Query whose get_component_model_class returns the shim's Class; fixtures cover a subject with three URIRef superclasses (one of them ignored) plus a blank-node restriction, and a subject with none.
